methods.name: GetService
methods.doc: The service of this class, made when the place lacks it. A name that is not a service class raises RE9001.

methods.name: FindService
methods.doc: The service of this class, or nil when the place lacks it.

properties.name: PlaceId
properties.doc: The place's id, from real.toml [compat.game] place_id (0 by default, as in an unpublished Studio place).

properties.name: GameId
properties.doc: The experience's id, from [compat.game] game_id (0 by default).

properties.name: CreatorId
properties.doc: The creator's id, from [compat.game] creator_id (0 by default).

properties.name: JobId
properties.doc: The server's id, from [compat.game] job_id (empty by default, as in Studio).

properties.name: PrivateServerId
properties.doc: The private server's id, from [compat.game] private_server_id (empty: not a private server).

properties.name: PrivateServerOwnerId
properties.doc: The private server owner's user id, from [compat.game] private_server_owner_id (0: not a private server).

methods.name: BindToClose
methods.doc: Calls the function when the game shuts down. Callbacks run side by side and may yield; shutdown waits for them for up to 30 s of game time.

classes.name: WorldRoot
classes.doc: A model that holds a simulated 3D world.

classes.name: Workspace
classes.note: Only the tree; physics and rendering properties come with their work packages.
classes.doc: The 3D world of the place: what is under it is simulated and drawn. Reached as the global workspace.

classes.name: ReplicatedStorage
classes.doc: A container both contexts can read.

classes.name: ServerScriptService
classes.doc: Holds the scripts that run on the server.

classes.name: ServerStorage
classes.doc: A container only the server reads.

classes.name: Lighting
classes.note: Only the tree; lighting properties come with the rendering work.
classes.doc: The place's lighting settings and sky.

classes.name: StarterPlayer
classes.doc: Settings and scripts given to each player. Holds StarterPlayerScripts and StarterCharacterScripts.

classes.name: StarterPlayerScripts
classes.doc: Scripts copied to each player when they join.

classes.name: StarterCharacterScripts
classes.doc: Scripts copied into each character when it spawns.

classes.name: BasePlayerGui
classes.doc: The base of the containers for screen interfaces.

classes.name: StarterGui
classes.note: Only the tree; screen interface behaviour comes with the UI work.
classes.doc: Screen interfaces copied to each player.

classes.name: CollectionService
classes.doc: Finds instances by tag and tells scripts when a tag is added or removed.

methods.name: AddTag
methods.doc: Adds a tag to an instance.

methods.name: RemoveTag
methods.doc: Removes a tag from an instance.

methods.name: HasTag
methods.doc: True if the instance has the tag.

methods.name: GetTagged
methods.doc: Every instance in the data model with the tag.

methods.name: GetInstanceAddedSignal
methods.doc: A signal that fires with each instance that gets the tag.

methods.name: GetInstanceRemovedSignal
methods.doc: A signal that fires with each instance that loses the tag.

classes.name: RunService
classes.doc: The frame events, functions bound to the render step, and which context a script runs in.

methods.name: BindToRenderStep
methods.doc: Calls the function every frame before the frame is drawn (client only), with the frame's delta time. Bindings run by priority, lowest first; equal priorities run in bind order.

methods.name: UnbindFromRenderStep
methods.doc: Removes the bindings with this name.

methods.name: IsStudio
methods.doc: True unless real.toml sets [compat.game] studio = false.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.doc: Always true: scripts only run while the game runs.

methods.name: IsEdit
methods.doc: Always false: scripts never run in edit mode.

events.name: PreRender
events.doc: Fires every frame before the frame is drawn, after the render-step bindings (client only).

events.name: RenderStepped
events.doc: Fires every frame after PreRender (client only).

events.name: PreAnimation
events.doc: Fires each simulation step before animations are applied.

events.name: PreSimulation
events.doc: Fires each simulation step before physics.

events.name: Stepped
events.doc: Fires each simulation step before physics, after PreSimulation, with the time since the game started.

events.name: PostSimulation
events.doc: Fires each simulation step after physics.

events.name: Heartbeat
events.doc: Fires each simulation step after PostSimulation; threads whose task.wait is due resume after it.

classes.name: UserSettings
classes.doc: The local user's settings, reached with the global function `UserSettings()`. It is a root of its own, not part of `game`.

methods.name: IsUserFeatureEnabled
methods.note: No user features exist offline, so it is always false.
methods.doc: Whether the user feature `name` is on.

classes.name: UserGameSettings
classes.note: Only SavedQualityLevel, which is stored and does not change rendering.
classes.doc: The local user's game settings, from `UserSettings():GetService("UserGameSettings")`.

properties.name: SavedQualityLevel
properties.note: Stored only: rendering quality does not follow it.
properties.doc: The graphics quality the user chose; Automatic lets the engine pick.
